# Untapped

> Untapped is a done-for-you global hiring and payroll service, and an alternative to outsourcing. You hire your own dedicated offshore teammates instead of sharing an outsourced team.

Untapped finds and hires a specialist for you, then employs them and runs payroll. The person is your teammate, working UK hours or your own hours.

This page, https://hire.tryuntapped.com, is where clients sign terms and pay the deposit.

## Who it is for

Untapped has placed people into 200+ businesses over 4+ years, including recruitment agencies, tech platforms, accountancy, marketing and other firms.

## Where people are hired

Hiring is mainly in South Africa and the Philippines, plus Latin America (LatAm). That includes employer of record (EOR) hiring in South Africa, the Philippines and Latin America: Untapped employs the teammate and runs payroll, so the client does not have to open a local entity.

## How it works

1. The client signs terms on hire.tryuntapped.com.
2. The client pays a refundable deposit of £1,000 per role. The page states this deposit is refundable if Untapped fails to deliver.
3. A delivery lead scopes the role.
4. Untapped sources, vets and presents a shortlist. The client interviews and hires.
5. Untapped then covers employment, payroll and the related admin. The page describes each placement as fully inclusive: EOR, HR, payroll, legal, IT and workspace, for one monthly cost.

A typical hire takes about 6 weeks. The term is a 90-day minimum, then monthly rolling, and clients can give 30 days' notice at any time. Cost is up to 70% cheaper than hiring in the UK, US or Australia.

## An alternative to outsourcing

People searching for outsourcing can hire their own dedicated offshore teammate here instead of sharing an outsourced team. The teammate works for the client, on the client's hours, in the client's tools.

## Key facts

- Service: done-for-you global hiring and payroll, for any specialist role
- Positioning: an alternative to outsourcing. Teammates, not outsources
- Hiring locations: mainly South Africa and the Philippines, plus Latin America
- Hours: UK hours, or the client's hours
- Time to hire: about 6 weeks
- Cost: up to 70% cheaper than hiring in the UK, US or Australia
- Deposit: £1,000 per role, shown on this site as refundable if Untapped fails to deliver
- Term: 90-day minimum, then monthly rolling. Clients can give 30 days' notice at any time
- Placed into 200+ businesses over 4+ years, including recruitment agencies, tech platforms, accountancy, marketing and other firms
- Hiring in overseas markets for over 4 years
- B Corp and mission-led
- Founder and CEO: Kyle Grainger, 17 years of hiring experience. https://www.linkedin.com/in/kyle-grainger/
- Legal entity: Untapped is a trading division of Create and Adapt Limited, company number 9723247, Unit 4, Greenway Farm, Bath Road, Bristol, BS30 5RL, United Kingdom
